artifact.reason: Defines document metadata schema: filename, doc_type, ingestion_timestamp, page_count, source_path, chunk_count. Primary identifier for document provenance.
Chunk model includes metadata: DocumentMetadata for parent document provenance. chunk.metadata.filename is the source document identifier.
QueryResult includes source_document field for attribution in search results.
Qdrant search implementation. Payload includes source_document, page_number, chunk_index. Supports filter by source_document (line 162).
SQL table search. Uses document_id column from financial_tables for attribution. _format_table_row includes page_number.
Qdrant storage. Payload includes source_document=chunk.metadata.filename (line 189, 250). 15 rich metadata fields stored.
Qdrant client singleton. Connects to settings.qdrant_host:qdrant_port. Environment-aware (test vs production).
PostgreSQL client singleton. Environment-aware (test port 5433, prod port 5432).
Session fixture sets APP_ENV=test, POSTGRES_PORT=5433. Ensures tests use test databases (Qdrant:6335, PostgreSQL:5433).

constraints.constraint: Document provenance tracked via chunk.metadata.filename field - this is the primary identifier
Qdrant payload includes source_document field for filtering - enables document-scoped queries
PostgreSQL financial_tables uses document_id column for document attribution
Tests MUST use test database environment (APP_ENV=test) to avoid production data pollution
Test databases: Qdrant port 6335, PostgreSQL port 5433 with raglite_ci credentials
Small test fixture (sample-small-3-pages.pdf) recommended for integration tests
Singleton pattern for database clients (get_qdrant_client, get_postgresql_connection)

tests.standards: pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests. Tests organized in tests/unit/, tests/integration/, tests/e2e/. Integration tests require @pytest.mark.preserve_collection or @pytest.mark.manages_collection_state markers. Session fixture configure_test_environment() ensures APP_ENV=test for all tests. Mock Mistral API calls via mock_mistral_api_globally session fixture to prevent real API calls.
